title: The connections beneath the sea
summaryZh: 视频通话和网购依赖哪些看不见的连接？英国一份白皮书提出保护海底基础设施的方案，并向公众征询意见。
levelReason: 编辑估计B1：以日常数字活动引入基础设施，使用连贯说明、定语从句和would区分方案与既成事实；配中文释义。

source.name: Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport / GOV.UK
source.title: Subsea cable saboteurs face jail and unlimited fines under new security crackdown

adaptation: 2026-10-27整理，依据2026-10-22机构英文叙述作同语言教学改写并配中文翻译；非当日原文。排除照片、直接引语和涉及特定国家活动的指控。首句为日常引入，末句为编辑阅读提示；题目与口语部分为教学补充。本文介绍提案，不是法律已生效的说明或法律建议。

sentences.text: A message to a friend may travel much farther than the distance between two phones suggests.
sentences.zh: 给朋友发的一条消息，其传输距离可能远远超过两部手机之间的距离。

sentences.text: According to a British government announcement published on 22 October 2026, cables on the seabed carry around 99 per cent of the United Kingdom’s international data.
sentences.zh: 根据英国政府2026年10月22日发布的公告，海底电缆承载着英国约99%的国际数据。

glosses.note: 单数名词，on the seabed 表示在海底。

sentences.text: These connections support a number of familiar activities, including video calls, online shopping and banking, even though users rarely see the equipment involved.
sentences.zh: 这些连接支持视频通话、网上购物和银行业务等日常活动，尽管用户很少看见相关设备。

sentences.text: There is also an energy connection: undersea pipelines provide 74 per cent of the country’s gas supply, while other cables transport electricity.
sentences.zh: 海底也承担能源连接：海底管道提供该国74%的天然气供应，另一些电缆则输送电力。

glosses.note: 复数，指输送天然气的管道。

sentences.text: The announcement presents proposals for protecting this infrastructure, rather than reporting that a new set of laws has already taken effect.
sentences.zh: 这份公告提出保护这些基础设施的方案，而不是宣布一套新法律已经生效。

sentences.text: A White Paper sets out changes to older legislation and begins a consultation lasting twelve weeks.
sentences.zh: 一份白皮书阐述修改旧有法律的方案，并启动为期十二周的意见征询。

glosses.note: 名词，指正式收集公众等各方意见的过程。

sentences.text: Industry representatives, experts and members of the public are invited to contribute their views before the final proposals are shaped.
sentences.zh: 在形成最终方案之前，行业代表、专家和公众受邀提出意见。

sentences.text: One proposed change concerns the companies that provide undersea telecommunications cables: they would have stronger duties to identify and manage risks to their networks.
sentences.zh: 其中一项拟议变化涉及海底通信电缆供应商：它们识别和管理网络风险的义务将加强。

glosses.note: 复数；这里指企业需要承担的责任。

sentences.text: Another would give the government powers to direct providers when steps are needed to protect national security.
sentences.zh: 另一项将赋予政府权力，在需要采取措施保护国家安全时向供应商发出指令。

sentences.text: The plans also include tougher penalties for people who damage important undersea infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 方案还包括对破坏重要海底基础设施者施加更严厉的处罚。

sentences.text: However, damage does not necessarily mean that someone deliberately attacked a cable, and the announcement describes a range of other causes.
sentences.zh: 不过，损坏并不一定意味着有人故意攻击电缆，公告也介绍了其他多种原因。

sentences.text: Anchors or fishing nets dragged across the seabed can cause faults, as can environmental hazards and technical failures.
sentences.zh: 拖过海底的船锚或渔网可能引发故障，环境危险和技术失灵也可能造成故障。

glosses.note: 句首复数名词，须保留大写。

sentences.text: The source describes the existing British network as highly resilient, while arguing that protection needs to keep pace with changing threats.
sentences.zh: 原文称英国现有网络具有很强的韧性，同时主张保护措施需要跟上威胁的变化。

sentences.text: For readers, the distinction between an existing connection, a reported risk and a proposed rule helps make a complex announcement easier to understand.
sentences.zh: 对读者来说，区分现有连接、报道中的风险和拟议规则，有助于理解复杂的公告。

words.note: 单数名词，on the seabed 表示在海底。
复数，指输送天然气的管道。
名词，指正式收集公众等各方意见的过程。
复数；这里指企业需要承担的责任。
句首复数名词，须保留大写。

phrases.note: take effect的过去分词形式，与has连用；本句否认法律已经生效。

sentences.note: does not necessarily mean表达“不一定意味着”，避免把某一结果直接归为单一原因。

questions.text: Which daily activity would you miss most if your internet connection stopped working?
questions.zh: 如果网络连接中断，你最不习惯失去哪项日常活动？

questions.text: Why is it useful to distinguish a proposal from a rule already in force?
questions.zh: 为什么区分提案与已生效规则很重要？

expressions.note: 原创讨论句架，用于说明日常依赖。

expressions.text: The proposal would…, but it has not yet…
expressions.zh: 这项提案将会……，但它尚未……
expressions.note: 原创讨论句架，注意不要把拟议变化当成现行安排。
